- **Item 7** (`S94-VII-AU-3HEB-BDI-LEVEL-3-ANCHOR`, [VERIFY]) lands the integer 3He-B BDI branch-count Level-3 anchor for §VII.AU.OP-PROJ, reading the winding from the pairing item 6 identifies (NOT from `T_signed`). **Depends on item 6** — internal sequential within W2; honest mechanical-closure outcome pre-registered if item 6 returns a winding-location divergence.
- **Item 8** (`S94-VII-AU-ALPHA-MINUS-3-LAYER-1`, [SIGN]) derives the asymptotic `L_max → ∞` α=−3 Layer-1 leading term via Friedrich-Bär saturation at `L ∈ [35, 100]` (the CORRIDOR-CONFIRMED-NUMERICAL-DEFERRED deferral, preserved through STAGE-3 — STAGE-3 did NOT discharge it).
